#   Abuse.ch › Feodo Tracker Botnet C2 › Indicators Of Compromise (IOCs)
#   Aggressive List
#   
#   Feodo Tracker tracks botnet command-and-control (C2) servers associated
#   with malware families such as Emotet, TrickBot, QakBot, and BazarLoader.
#   
#   The IOC datasets include known and historical botnet C2 IP addresses for
#   threat detection, SIEM enrichment, and network monitoring.
#   
#   blocklist_c2_recommended:
#       Active botnet C2 servers with a low false positive rate.
#       Recommended for blocking live botnet traffic.
#   
#   blocklist_c2_iocs_normal:
#       Botnet C2 IPs seen within the past 30 days.
#       Intended for SIEM enrichment and threat detection.
#   
#   blocklist_c2_iocs_aggressive:
#       All botnet C2 IPs ever observed by Feodo Tracker.
#       High false positive rate due to IP reuse.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malicious data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
